description.p: EngPlayer is a modern, fast, and lightweight media player developed with Python and GTK4 for Linux desktops. It serves as a user-friendly entertainment hub that brings your local media library, VOD content, Podcasts, and live streams under one roof.

ul.li: IPTV Support: Seamless integration with Xtream Codes API and M3U playlists.
Smart EPG & Catch-up: Real-time program guides and archive playback support.
Recorder (PVR): Record live streams or schedule recordings for later.
Podcast Integration: Manage library, listen to episodes, and smart resume support.
External Stream: Direct playback support for external video and audio URLs.
Cinematic VOD: Automatic metadata fetching (Posters, Cast, Plot) via TMDb integration.
Trakt.tv Sync: Automatically tracks what you're watching (Scrobbling).
Local Library: Manage your Video, Music, and Picture collections with album art support.
Advanced Player: Video Settings (Brightness/Contrast), 10-Band Equalizer, Subtitle download, and PiP mode.

description.p: This release brings new content management features, UI enhancements, and under-the-hood Flatpak modernizations, with special thanks to our contributors

ul.li: New Feature: Added import and export functionality for Xtream Codes and M3U URLs
New Feature: Added channel and favorites editor functionality
New Feature: Added an option to select an external player directly from the channel list for DVB and Teletext
New Feature: Added download functionality for VOD and series content (Thanks to @ycderman)
New Feature: Added the ability to add VOD and series to favorites
New Feature: Added a "Recently Added" section for VOD and series (Thanks to @Eslamasabry)
UI: Various user interface (UI) updates and overall improvements
Maintenance: Updated the Flatpak runtime to version 50, migrated configuration to YAML format, and integrated FEDC (Thanks to @yakushabb)

description.p: This hotfix resolves a critical application crash during channel playback.

ul.li: Fix: Resolved a critical issue where the application would crash during channel playback if the EPG provider link was missing, broken, or failed to download.

description.p: This major release introduces Timeshift, a smart subtitle engine, compressed EPG support, detailed actor profiles, and extensive personalization options.

ul.li: New Feature: Added Timeshift to pause and resume live broadcasts.
New Feature: Added detailed Actor Profiles with biographies and known works.
New Feature: Native support for downloading and decompressing .xml.gz EPG files.
New Feature: Introduced Advanced EPG with both Grid and List views.
New Feature: Smart Subtitle Engine for automatic and flawless character encoding.
New Feature: Added Video Playback Speed control and Aspect Ratio options.
New Feature: VOD and Series descriptions can now be translated into the system language.
New Feature: Global Search to find content quickly across the app.
New Feature: Quick Channel History to view and switch between the last 30 watched channels.
New Feature: Programmable Sleep Timer and Advanced List Sorting (A-Z/Z-A).
UI: Added new color themes and customizable font styles and sizes.
General: Minor UI enhancements and various bug fixes.

description.p: This release introduces a refreshed UI, full-screen channel management, and buffer control.

ul.li: New User Interface: A refreshed and cleaner look for a better user experience.
Full-Screen Channel List: Access and switch channels directly while in full-screen mode.
Category Management: Added ability to hide/show specific Bouquets, VOD, and Series.
Stream Buffer Settings: Adjust stream buffer duration for smoother playback.
Fix: Resolved trailer playback issues.
Fix: Improved menu button responsiveness.
Fix: Resolved PiP window disappearing when minimizing.

description.p: This release addresses playback synchronization issues and display bugs.

ul.li: Live Stream Fix: Resolved an issue where the video would pause/freeze while audio continued playing during live streams.
Display Fix: Fixed full-screen scaling issues on 1024x768 resolutions.
General: Various minor bug fixes and improvements.

description.p: This update introduces Podcast support, external stream playback, and video enhancements.

ul.li: New Feature: Added Podcast support and library.
New Feature: Added external URL playback option.
New Feature: Added Video Settings menu.
New Feature: Added Channel Information display.
Fix: Resolved IPTV slider bar functionality issues.
Fix: Corrected EPG logo matching logic.

description.p: This update introduces visual improvements and better version management.

ul.li: Dynamic EPG: Current program titles are now displayed directly in the channel list.
Visual Progress Bars: Added sleek indicators to track current program completion.
Unified Versioning: Centralized version control under core settings for better synchronization.
Initial support for Xtream Codes and M3U.
Added Background Recording and Scheduler.
Implemented TMDb and Trakt.tv integration.
